description: This file defines the JobTitleDao class, which handles data access operations related to JobTitle entities in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving, counting, deleting, and saving job titles, as well as managing associated attachments.

classes.name: JobTitleDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for managing Job Title entities, including CRUD operations and related attachments within the OrangeHRM HRM system.

methods.name: getJobTitleList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of job titles, optionally filtered to only active ones.

methods.name: getJobTitlesForEmployee
methods.description: Fetches job titles associated with a specific employee by employee number.

methods.name: getJobTitles
methods.description: Retrieves a list of job titles based on filtering parameters.

methods.name: getJobTitlesPaginator
methods.description: Creates a paginated query for job titles based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getJobTitlesCount
methods.description: Counts the number of job titles matching filter criteria.

methods.name: deleteJobTitle
methods.description: Marks job titles as deleted based on provided IDs.

methods.name: getJobTitleById
methods.description: Fetches a single job title entity by its ID.

methods.name: getExistingJobTitleIds
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of existing (non-deleted) job titles given a list of IDs.

methods.name: getJobSpecAttachmentById
methods.description: Fetches a job specification attachment by its ID.

methods.name: saveJobTitle
methods.description: Persists a JobTitle entity to the database.

methods.name: getJobSpecificationByJobTitleId
methods.description: Retrieves partial job specification attachment details for a given job title ID.
